## Change

Describe the user-visible problem and resulting behavior.

## Validation

List checks actually run, platform/version, and remaining limits.

- [ ] No private keys, profiles, invitation tokens or user data included.
- [ ] Product/status changes reflected in both README.md and README.ru.md, or not applicable.
- [ ] Documentation links/images checked; Mermaid rendered if changed.
- [ ] Release/deployment changes and rollback described, or not applicable.

- [ ] If a version changed, update STATUS/PLAN, the release report and applicable RU/EN downloads/checksums; distinguish candidate, installed, public and invitation-page versions.
